book.name: APOCALIPSIS
book.title: APOCALIPSIS I tsictesʌbal Jesucristo tsa' bʌ pʌsbenti Juan

content: I jo'ticlel ángel tsi' wusu i trompeta. Tsaj q'uele jump'ejl ec' tsa' bʌ yajli ti panchan c'ʌlʌl ti pañimil. Tsa' aq'uenti i llavejlel jini ch'en mach bʌ anix mi' tajben i yebal.
Tsi' jambe i ti' jini tam bʌ ch'en. Tsa' loq'ui buts' ti ch'en lajal bajche' i buts'il colem c'ajc. Tsa' ic'a jini q'uin yic'ot pañimil cha'an jini buts' loq'uem bʌ ti ch'en.
Tsa' loq'ui cabʌl sajc' ya' ti buts'. Tsa' pam pujqui ti pañimil. Tsa' aq'uenti i p'ʌtʌlel che' bajche' i p'ʌtʌlel siñan.
Tsa' subenti sajc' cha'an ma'anic mi' c'ux jam mi pimel mi te'. Cojach mi' c'uxob jini winicob mach bʌ añobic i sellojlel Dios ti' pam.

Ma'anic tsa' aq'uenti i p'ʌtʌlel cha'an mi' tsʌnsañob winicob come tic'bilob. Pero tsa' aq'uenti i p'ʌtʌlel cha'an mi' tic'lañob jo'p'ejl uw cha'an mi' yʌq'ueñob wocol che' bajche' i c'uxel i yej siñan che' mi' c'ux winic.
Ti jim bʌ ora winicob mi caj i lon sʌclañob bajche' mi mejlel i chʌmelob. Ma'anic mi caj i tajob. Anquese yomob chʌmel, mach mejlicob.
Che' yilal ili sajc' bajche' caballo chajpʌbil bʌ cha'an guerra. An i corona tac ti' jol melbil bʌ ti oro. Che'ʌch i wut bajche' i wut winicob.
Lajal i tsutsel i jol bajche' i tsutsel i jol x'ixic. Lajal i bʌquel i yej bajche' i bʌquel i yej colem bajlum.
An i sujl wechel ti' tajn lajal bajche' tsucu taq'uin. Lajal tsi' cha'le t'an i wich' bajche' cabʌl carreta mu' bʌ i tujc'an majlel caballo che' mi' cha'len ajñel ti guerra.
C'ux i ñej che' bajche' i ñej siñan. An i p'ʌtʌlel ti' ñej cha'an mi' tic'lan winicob jo'p'ejl uw.
An i rey jini sajc', jiñʌch i yángel jini ch'en mach bʌ anix mi' tajben i yebal. I c'aba'ʌch Abadón ti' t'an hebreo, jiñʌch Apolión ti' t'an griego. I sujmlel i c'aba' jiñʌch “Yujil bʌ Jisaya”.
Tsa'ix ñumi jini ñaxan bʌ wocol. Awilan, tal to yambʌ cha'yajl wocol.
I wʌcticlel ángel tsi' wusu i trompeta. Tsa cubibe i t'an loq'uem bʌ ti chʌnts'ijt xulub am bʌ ti jini pulʌntib melbil bʌ ti oro ya' ti' tojel Dios.
I wʌcticlel ángel, jini chucul bʌ i cha'an trompeta tsa' subenti: Jiti jini chʌntiquil ángelob cʌchʌlo' bʌ ti colem ja' i c'aba' Eufrates. Che' tsa' subenti.
Tsa' jijtiyob jini chʌntiquil ángelob chajpʌbilo' bʌ cha'an ili ora, yic'ot ili q'uin, yic'ot ili uw, yic'ot ili jabil cha'an mi' tsʌnsañob winicob, jujuntiquil loq'uem bʌ ti u'uxtiquil.
I tsicol jini cabʌl soldadojob c'ʌchʌlo' bʌ ti caballo jiñʌch lujunc'al millón. Tsa cubi jaybajc' i tsicol.

Tsaj q'uele cabʌl caballo yic'ot jini c'ʌchʌlo' bʌ. An i mʌjquil i tajn jini c'ʌchʌlo' bʌ, chʌchʌc bajche' c'ajc, yʌjyʌx bajche' jacinto, c'ʌnc'ʌn bajche' azufre. Che' yilal i jol caballo bajche' i jol colem bajlum. Tsa' loq'ui c'ajc ti' yej yic'ot buts' yic'ot azufre.
Tsa' tsʌnsʌntiyob winicob jujuntiquil loq'uem bʌ ti u'uxtiquil, cha'an ti' caj jini uxchajp wocol, c'ajc yic'ot buts' yic'ot azufre, tsa' bʌ loq'ui ti' yej caballo.
Come an i p'ʌtʌlel ti' yej yic'ot ti' ñej jini caballo. Che' yilal i ñej bajche' lucum. An tac i jol ti' ñej. Tsi' c'ʌñʌyob i low winicob.

Yambʌ winicob mach bʌ anic tsa' chʌmiyob ti jini wocol ma'anic tsi' cʌyʌyob i mel jontol bʌ i melbal. Ma'anic tsi' cʌyʌyob i ch'ujutesan xibajob, yic'ot dios oro tac, yic'ot dios plata tac, yic'ot dios c'ʌnc'ʌn taq'uin tac, yic'ot dios xajlel tac, yic'ot dios te' tac, mach bʌ anic mi' c'otel i wut, mach bʌ anic mi' yubin t'an, mach bʌ yujilic xʌmbal.
Ma'anic tsi' cʌyʌyob tsʌnsa, mi wujt, mi ts'i'lel, mi xujch'.
